name: Check that agent tools in different workspaces do not share files
description: An AI agent writes a file with File System Tools in the workspace alpha, finds it with a Glob Tool in alpha, and checks that a List Directory Tool in the workspace beta cannot see it. It shows how the Workspace Name option keeps tool files apart.
shortDescription: Shows that the Workspace Name option keeps the files of agent tools apart.
keyFeatures: Workspace Name option on each Agent Utils tool
Two workspaces, alpha and beta, in one agent
PASS/FAIL report in the execution log
prerequisites: Server setting bytechef.ai.agent-utils.file-system.enabled=true (BYTECHEF_AI_AGENT_UTILS_FILE_SYSTEM_ENABLED), which turns on the File System, Glob, Grep and List Directory tools
idealFor: Administrators of self-hosted ByteChef who want to check how the Agent Utils file and shell tools behave before they let agent builders use them.
steps: Trigger: the workflow starts when you click Run in the workflow editor.
Run the checks: the AI Agent writes a file in alpha and looks for it from alpha and from beta.
Log the report: the Logger step prints the agent's PASS/FAIL table to the execution log.
